description: UX/accessibility + analytics, independent of FEAT-001. (A) Add a non-color answer cue — a check icon on the correct tile and a cross on the chosen-wrong tile — via one shared AnswerBadge widget layered over all five multiple-choice games (Memory Match has no choice grid, skip it). Existing color + SFX stay; the icon is an additional channel for red/green color-blind kids. (B) Add a local-only, no-PII, COPPA-safe AnalyticsService (aggregate counters in shared_preferences with an 'analytics_' key prefix, no network, no fine-grained timestamps) exposed behind an AnalyticsSink interface, wired into PlayerProfile.onRoundFinished/recordGamePlayed as an optional injected sink and attached once at the hub.
steps: A1. Create lib/core/widgets/answer_badge.dart: a const StatelessWidget AnswerBadge({required bool show, required bool correct}). When !show return const SizedBox.shrink(). When show, render a ~26px circular chip with a white Icons.check_rounded (correct) or Icons.close_rounded (wrong) on an AppTheme.success/AppTheme.danger fill, with an ink border (AppTheme.comicBorder or ~2.5px AppTheme.ink) and AppTheme.comicShadow. Add a doc comment: it is an ADDITIONAL non-color channel over the existing color + SFX, for red/green color-blind kids.

A2. In lib/games/number_quest/screens/game_screen.dart _ChoiceGrid, wrap each ComicButton tile in a Stack(clipBehavior: Clip.none) and add Positioned(top: -6, right: -6, child: AnswerBadge(show: answered && (isCorrect || isSelected), correct: isCorrect)). Import ../../../core/widgets/answer_badge.dart.

A3. In lib/games/word_wizard/screens/wizard_game_screen.dart _ChoiceGrid, same Stack+AnswerBadge over the ComicButton tiles using index == question.correctIndex / index == selectedIndex. Import the badge.
A4. In lib/games/shape_safari/screens/safari_game_screen.dart _ChoiceGrid, add the badge to BOTH the shape Container tiles and the text ComicButton tiles (wrap each in a Stack). Import the badge.

A5. In lib/games/clock_hero/screens/clock_game_screen.dart, add the badge to BOTH the _TextChoices ComicButton tiles and the clockChoices Container tiles, using index == question.correctIndex / index == selectedIndex. Import the badge.

A6. In lib/games/money_math/screens/money_game_screen.dart, add the badge to _TextChoices (covers countCoins and makeChange if present), _TwoPiles, and _PileChoices, using index == question.correctIndex / index == selectedIndex. Import the badge. Keep every existing fill/text-color/SFX behavior untouched — the badge is purely additive. Do NOT touch Memory Match.

B1. Create lib/core/services/analytics_service.dart. Define `abstract class AnalyticsSink` with: void recordGameOpened(String gameId); void recordRound({required int correct, required bool threeStars, required bool bossBeaten}); Future<void> updateSnapshots({required int streak, required int petLevel, required int coins}). Implement `class AnalyticsService extends ChangeNotifier implements AnalyticsSink`, modeled on PlayerProfile/GameState: a SharedPreferences field, Future<void> load(), all keys prefixed 'analytics_' (e.g. analytics_opens_<gameId>, analytics_rounds_total, analytics_correct_total, analytics_threestar_total, analytics_boss_total, analytics_snap_streak, analytics_snap_pet, analytics_snap_coins), aggregate COUNTERS only with defensive getInt(...) ?? 0, persisting on each update. NO network, NO PII, NO timestamps finer than a day bucket (store no timestamp this batch). Top-of-file doc comment stating LOCAL-ONLY and COPPA-safe. Expose simple getters for the counters so tests can read them.

B2. In lib/core/services/player_profile.dart import analytics_service.dart, add a nullable field `AnalyticsSink? _analytics;` and `void attachAnalytics(AnalyticsSink sink) { _analytics = sink; }`. In recordGamePlayed(...) call `_analytics?.recordGameOpened(gameId);` as the FIRST line (before the already-played early return, so repeat opens still count). In onRoundFinished(...), after the existing work, call `_analytics?.recordRound(correct: correct, threeStars: threeStars, bossBeaten: bossBeaten);` and `await _analytics?.updateSnapshots(streak: dailyStreak, petLevel: petLevel, coins: coins);`. PlayerProfile must depend only on the AnalyticsSink interface, never the concrete AnalyticsService.

B3. In lib/app/game_hub_screen.dart import analytics_service.dart, add `final AnalyticsService _analytics = AnalyticsService();`, and in initState load it and call `_profile.attachAnalytics(_analytics)` within the existing _profile.load().then(...) chain so the sink is attached before any game open or round. No UI surfacing this batch.

B4. Add test/analytics_test.dart: with SharedPreferences.setMockInitialValues({}), construct AnalyticsService, load(), call recordGameOpened('number_quest') twice and recordRound(correct: 3, threeStars: true, bossBeaten: false), assert the aggregate getters reflect the counts; then construct a fresh AnalyticsService, load(), and assert the persisted values read back. Assert the service writes only keys beginning with 'analytics_'.
acceptance_criteria: lib/core/widgets/answer_badge.dart exists and renders a check (correct) / cross (wrong) comic chip only when show is true.

All five game screens (number_quest, shape_safari, word_wizard, clock_hero, money_math) show the badge on answered correct and chosen-wrong tiles, for both ComicButton and Container tile shapes; Memory Match is unchanged.
Existing color fills, text-color flips, and SFX are unchanged; existing widget tests still pass.
lib/core/services/analytics_service.dart exists as AnalyticsService implementing an AnalyticsSink interface, local-only, keys all 'analytics_'-prefixed, no network/PII/fine timestamps.
PlayerProfile forwards opens and round-end to the injected sink via the interface only; the hub attaches AnalyticsService once.
`flutter test` passes including test/analytics_test.dart; `flutter build web` shows 'Built build\web'.
verification: & "$env:USERPROFILE\flutter\bin\flutter.bat" test  — all tests pass including analytics_test.dart
findings: Implemented. (A) New lib/core/widgets/answer_badge.dart: const AnswerBadge({show, correct}) renders a 26px circular check_rounded/close_rounded chip (AppTheme.success/danger fill, 2.5px ink border, comicShadow offset 2) and SizedBox.shrink when !show. Layered via Stack(clipBehavior: Clip.none) + Positioned(top:-6,right:-6) over every answered correct/chosen-wrong tile in all 5 multiple-choice games: number_quest _ChoiceGrid (ComicButton), word_wizard _ChoiceGrid (ComicButton), shape_safari _ChoiceGrid (BOTH shape Container and text ComicButton), clock_hero _TextChoices (ComicButton) and _ClockChoices (Container), money_math _TextChoices (ComicButton; covers countCoins AND the FEAT-001 makeChange case), _TwoPiles and _PileChoices (Containers). Memory Match untouched. All existing fills/text-color flips/SFX left intact; badge is purely additive. (B) New lib/core/services/analytics_service.dart: abstract AnalyticsSink + AnalyticsService(ChangeNotifier) local-only/COPPA-safe, all keys 'analytics_'-prefixed (opens_<gameId>, rounds_total, correct_total, threestar_total, boss_total, snap_streak, snap_pet, snap_coins), defensive getInt(...)??0, no network/PII/timestamps. Getters exposed for tests (opensFor, roundsTotal, correctTotal, threeStarTotal, bossTotal, snapshotStreak/PetLevel/Coins). PlayerProfile gained nullable _analytics + attachAnalytics(sink); recordGameOpened called as FIRST line of recordGamePlayed (counts repeat opens), recordRound+updateSnapshots called at end of onRoundFinished; depends only on the interface. Hub (game_hub_screen) owns a single AnalyticsService, loads it and attaches in the _profile.load().then chain before any game open. test/analytics_test.dart added (opens x2, one round, snapshot write, reload persistence, analytics_-prefix-only assertion). Verified: `flutter build web` -> 'Built build\web'; `flutter test` -> All tests passed (9/9). Note: sync AnalyticsSink.recordGameOpened/recordRound rely on shared_preferences' synchronous in-memory cache update for immediate getter reads; disk write is fire-and-forget which is fine for aggregate counters. No UI surfaces analytics this batch.
